status: Source implemented; Unity14/14 cases pass; signed release1.0.1(2) native Android36 age/consent matrix and merged-manifest checks pass. Actual ads remain blocked by missing UMP publisher forms.
artifact_scope: This applies only to the next build. Uploaded AAB 1.0.0 (1) does not contain this privacy gate and must not be represented as containing it.

policy.sdk_initialization: No Firebase, Remote Config, UMP or Mobile Ads initialization requested by managed bootstrap
No Firebase, Remote Config, UMP or Mobile Ads initialization requested by managed bootstrap

policy.ads: Only after UMP success and CanRequestAds; UMP under-age signal, GMA Teen plus TFUA, maximum G rating, personalization disabled

policy.firebase_analytics_remote_config: Explicit analytics choice required; default off; only opt-in initializes Firebase and Remote Config
policy.ads: UMP success and CanRequestAds; maximum G rating and personalization disabled regardless of analytics choice

implementation.local_age: Only coarse band persisted in PlayerPrefs; no date of birth. No raw age-band Analytics event. Eligible ad requests do carry coarse age-treatment/under-consent-age signals.
implementation.startup: Before age/choice completion, service bootstrap only connects local no-ads and analytics facade. Firebase dependency check, native Ads dispatcher and UMP are deferred.
implementation.analytics: Pre-consent/pre-ready event queue removed. Denied events are dropped. Adult opt-in grants AnalyticsStorage only; AdStorage, AdUserData and AdPersonalization remain denied.
implementation.revocation: Turns off Analytics collection, denies consent, resets local Analytics data, invalidates async permits and prevents further Remote Config work. It does not delete already delivered server data or cancel a request already transmitted.
implementation.callback_guards: Every consent/init/fetch continuation checks a monotonically changing choice revision; withdrawing then granting again cannot resurrect old callbacks.
implementation.ads: Errors now fail closed rather than resuming ads from a cached eligible status. Native provider checks the age gate on each readiness/load path.
implementation.android_build: Postprocessor removes FirebaseInitProvider and MobileAdsInitProvider auto-start components; sets Analytics and default consent false; disables Analytics AAID; removes AD_ID and AdServices permissions; delays Ads measurement initialization.
implementation.ios_build: Postprocessor supplies analytics/ad-storage/personalization/IDFA/IDFV defaults false and delays Ads measurement. Existing SDK service boot remains Android-only. iOS behavior is not claimed verified by Android tests.

data_safety_delta.collection_control_for_ad_types: Required in the app-wide Play form unless all eligible users receive a genuine global collection choice. Declining optional game Analytics does not disable ad SDK operational data.

other_actions.scope: Game outcome/progression events only for adult opt-in.
other_actions.shared: Unverified; inspect GA sharing/linked Ads/export settings before choosing a final answer.

other_personal_info.scope: Coarse teen/under-consent-age ad-treatment signals. No birthday, name or login.

data_safety_delta.advertising_id: Do not infer no identifiers. Removed AD_ID permission blocks ordinary AAID access on Android 13+; older supported Android versions require separate verification. App-set and app-instance identifiers remain relevant for eligible users.
data_safety_delta.no_account: No app account creation, real IAP provider or Crashlytics integration added.
data_safety_delta.not_all_data_optional: Only developer gameplay Analytics is a user-selectable opt-in; SDK ad processing remains separate.
